About.lead: Behind Reich Studio isn't a team of twenty people. It's Sofija.

About.p3: When we work together, you talk to me — not an account manager juggling three other clients.

faq.q: Are these final prices?
faq.a: These are starting prices. The exact price depends on your field and scope — we clarify that in the first call, before anything becomes binding.

faq.q: Do I have to commit long-term?
faq.a: Starter is one-time, no subscription. For Growth and Full-Service, we discuss the term that makes sense for you in the first call.

faq.q: What if I don't know which package fits?
faq.a: That's the norm, not the exception. In the first call we look together at where you stand and what actually makes sense.

faq.q: Can I switch later?
faq.a: Yes. The packages are a starting point, not a contract set in stone — we adjust as your needs change.

faq.q: How fast will I see results?
faq.a: With Starter, usually within a few weeks of project start. With Growth and Full-Service it depends on scope — we discuss concrete timelines in the first call.

faq.q: What if my field is very niche?
faq.a: That's exactly what Reich Studio is for. The more specific your field, the more clearly we can build trust with your clients — we find the right approach together.

testimonial.quote:
We at All In One had a really positive experience working with Sofija. The collaboration was straightforward, pleasant and professional from the start. She took a range of photos and videos for us and put together a genuinely great video from them.

What we especially appreciated was that Sofija understood what we had in mind while also bringing her own ideas to the table. During the shoot she was engaged, flexible, and adapted well to what we wanted. We're very happy with the final result too.

Overall, working together was genuinely fun, and we can absolutely recommend Sofija and her work. Thank you for the great collaboration!

faq.q: Do I need coding skills?
faq.a: No. Every step is written to be followable without any code knowledge — from setting up Claude to your first automation.

faq.q: How long does it take to implement?
faq.a: The roadmap in the playbook is built for 7 days at 20–40 minutes each. If you want to dive in right away, you can build the foundation in one afternoon.

faq.q: What other tools do I need?
faq.a: Claude, a Notion knowledge base (free), and an automation tool like Zapier, Make, or n8n — the playbook explains which one fits you best.

faq.q: How do I get the playbook after buying?
faq.a: As a PDF download right after purchase, in portrait and landscape format.

faq.q: Is this the same as working with Reich Studio?
faq.a: No. The playbook is for doing it yourself. If you'd rather have someone set up the whole foundation — website, Brain, automation — for you, that's Reich Studio's Starter approach — book a first call for that.

AiAutomationPage.metaTitle: AI Automation for Marketing | Reich Studio Sursee
AiAutomationPage.metaDescription: AI automation for marketing in Sursee: content, enquiries and follow-ups run automatically. Not a software project — a marketing system that keeps running without you.
AiAutomationPage.heroSubtext: I build AI-powered workflows that take over the repetitive work — so you can focus on clients instead of copy-paste.
AiAutomationPage.introLead: Most automation providers build you software. I take over your marketing.
AiAutomationPage.introBody: If you need a customer portal or a custom application, a software firm serves you better. I use AI where visibility is at stake: content that gets made without you sitting down for it, enquiries that do not slip through, follow-ups that send themselves. Marketing work a machine can take over — not an IT project.

blocks.title: Capture enquiries automatically
blocks.text: Contact forms, DMs and emails land in your system already structured — with a notification, so nothing slips through.

blocks.title: Follow-ups that send themselves
blocks.text: Anyone who reaches out gets the right message at the right time, without you having to remember anything.

blocks.title: Content distribution
blocks.text: One piece gets prepared and published across several channels automatically, instead of you adapting it by hand three times.

blocks.title: Social media automation
blocks.text: Comments, DMs and interested people get answered and recorded automatically — for example through an n8n workflow.

blocks.title: Connect your internal tools
blocks.text: Your tools finally talk to each other: form, calendar, Notion, email and invoicing as one chain instead of five islands.

blocks.title: Reporting without manual work
blocks.text: The numbers collect themselves. You get an overview that is actually accurate, without maintaining spreadsheets.

faq.q: What does AI automation cost?
faq.a: A clearly scoped first workflow starts at CHF 2'800 one-time. Ongoing support with several automations runs from CHF 2'500 per month. We work out what makes sense for you on the first call.

faq.q: Do I need technical knowledge?
faq.a: No. I build and maintain the system. You end up with something that runs, plus a short explanation of what happens where.

faq.q: Which tools do you use?
faq.a: It depends on the job — often n8n for workflows, Notion as the data layer, and various AI models for text and image work. I pick based on your needs, not on a favourite tool.

faq.q: How long does it take?
faq.a: A first working automation is usually live within two to four weeks. Larger systems then grow step by step.

faq.q: Do you only work in Sursee?
faq.a: I am based in Sursee and work with a lot of clients from central Switzerland. The work runs mostly remote though, so location is not a limitation.

AiAutomationPage.ctaHeading: Where are you losing time right now?
AiAutomationPage.ctaSubtext: On the first call we look at your workflows and find out what can be automated.

MarketingAutomationPage.metaDescription: Marketing automation for freelancers and small businesses in Sursee: content, follow-ups and leads run automatically — no agency retainer, no jargon.
MarketingAutomationPage.heroSubtext: Stay visible without spending time on it every day — with systems instead of constant effort.
MarketingAutomationPage.introLead: Marketing rarely fails on the idea. It fails because nobody has time to keep it up.
MarketingAutomationPage.introBody: You know you should post regularly and follow up with people who showed interest. But between client appointments it never happens. Instead of handing you another to-do list, I build a process that keeps running even when you are buried in day-to-day work for three weeks.

blocks.title: A content calendar that fills itself
blocks.text: Topics get prepared and scheduled automatically, instead of you facing a blank page every Monday.

blocks.title: Lead capture with no gaps
blocks.text: Every enquiry lands in the right place automatically — with source, date and status.

blocks.title: Automatic follow-up messages
blocks.text: Interested people get the right message at the right time, even when it is not on your mind.

blocks.title: Newsletter without manual work
blocks.text: Sign-up, welcome message and sending run as one chain instead of three separate tasks.

blocks.title: Repurposing your content
blocks.text: One longer piece automatically turns into several shorter formats for different channels.

blocks.title: An overview you can trust
blocks.text: You see at a glance what is working — without collecting numbers by hand.

faq.q: How is this different from a traditional agency?
faq.a: An agency does the marketing for you as long as you keep paying. I build you a system that belongs to you and keeps running. No retainer that has to continue forever for anything to happen.

faq.q: What does it cost?
faq.a: Getting started with a scoped system is CHF 2'800 one-time, ongoing work from CHF 2'500 per month. Details are on the pricing page.

faq.q: Does this work for small businesses?
faq.a: Especially then. The smaller the team, the bigger the effect when recurring tasks disappear.

faq.q: Do I have to switch my existing tools?
faq.a: Usually not. I mostly connect what you already use rather than forcing something new on you.

faq.q: What happens if something stops working?
faq.a: You contact me directly, not a support ticket system. With ongoing support, maintenance is included.

MarketingAutomationPage.ctaSubtext: A 20-minute first call is enough to see where the biggest lever is.
